'''Straugh''' was the name of a giant [[Grophet]] living on the [[Horizon Island]] of [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]] until [[3637 BBY]], when he was killed.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Straugh the Grophet appears in the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]'' expansion, released on [[December 2]], [[2014]]. Killing him and two other grophets is required to access a set of [[datacron]]s on Rishi.

==Appearances==
*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]'' {{1st}}
